name: Anguillara Sabazia (Italy)
description: Vertical bicolour of white and blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Anguillara Sabazia (a tower on blue in a yellow cartouche) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Anguillara Sabazia, a comune in Lazio; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office. The arms were recognised by decree of the Head of Government on 4 February 1933.

features.role: Anguillara Sabazia arms — tower on blue in a yellow cartouche, crowned, within branches
